answer: Zero-knowledge proof-of-personhood resists Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to present a cryptographic proof and deterministic nullifier from a verified human sponsor before crossing the onboarding bridge. With the stability of quartz, this nullifier caps active keys per sponsor across the agent reef, forcing attackers to recruit scarce verified humans for each fake identity. However, paid biometric proxies and coerced credential sharing can still undermine uniqueness.
